title: Low END

services.name: Exhibition Program
services.desc: Join us to celebrate the opening of the 2026 Benefit Art Auction Exhibition! Experience more than 300 works of art by local, regional, and national artists participating in this year's auction. Current Bemis Center members and 2026 participating auction artists may also join us for an exclusive exhibition preview directly preceding the public reception, from 6 to 7 PM. Beginning Monday, October 5, all artwork is available for purchase at Buy it Now prices, 150% of retail price, until Friday, October 30, when bidding begins at 70% of retail price. Participating artists receive up to 50% commission on the sale of their work. All other proceeds from the Benefit Art Auction raise critical funds

blurb: LOW END is Bemis Center’s music venue and an integral part of the Sound Art + Experimental Music Program. The unique artist-designed space located in Bemis’s lower level includes custom seating, theatrical lighting, an anamorphic perspective stage, and industrial-grade audio equipment. LOW END features free live shows by local, national, and international sound artists, composers, and experimental musicians.
